20489-henry-of-monmouth-volume-2-or-memo.title: Henry Of Monmouth Volume 2 Or Memoirs Of The Life And Charac
20489-henry-of-monmouth-volume-2-or-memo.creator: Unknown
20489-henry-of-monmouth-volume-2-or-memo.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. died at Westminster on Monday, March 20, 1413, and Henry of Monmouth's proclamation bears date on the morrow, March 21.[1] Never perhaps was the accession of any prince to the throne of a kingdom hailed with a more general or enthusiastic welcome. If serious minds had entertained forebodings of evil from his reign, (as we (p. 002) believe they had not,) all feelings seem to have been absorbed in one burst of gladness.

arxiv-2108-03490.title: Clustering Algorithms to Analyze the Road Traffic Crashes
arxiv-2108-03490.creator: Mahnaz Rafia Islam, Israt Jahan Jenny, Moniruzzaman Nayon, Md. Rajibul Islam, Md Amiruzzaman, M. Abdullah-Al-Wadud
arxiv-2108-03490.description: Abstract Selecting an appropriate clustering method as well as an optimal number of clusters in road accident data is at times confusing and difficult. This paper analyzes shortcomings of different existing techniques applied to cluster accident-prone areas and recommends using Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) and Ordering Points To Identify the Clustering Structure (OPTICS) to overcome them.

arxiv-2207-10476.title: Efficiency of the Moscow Stock Exchange before 2022
arxiv-2207-10476.creator: Andrey Shternshis, Piero Mazzarisi, Stefano Marmi
arxiv-2207-10476.description: Abstract This paper investigates the degree of efficiency for the Moscow Stock Exchange. A market is called efficient if prices of its assets fully reflect all available information. We show that the degree of market efficiency is significantly low for most of the months from 2012 to 2021.

arxiv-2407-16119.title: Uncertainty-Aware Deep Neural Representations for Visual Analysis of Vector Field Data
arxiv-2407-16119.creator: Atul Kumar, Siddharth Garg, and Soumya Dutta
arxiv-2407-16119.description: Abstract The widespread use of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) has recently resulted in their application to challenging scientific visualization tasks. While advanced DNNs demonstrate impressive generalization abilities, understanding factors like prediction quality, confidence, robustness, and uncertainty is crucial. These insights aid application scientists in making informed decisions.

arxiv-2502-08505.title: Bridging Domain Adaptation and Graph Neural Networks: A Tensor-Based Framework for Effective Label Propagation
arxiv-2502-08505.creator: Tao Wen, Elynn Chen, Yuzhou Chen, Qi Lei
arxiv-2502-08505.description: Abstract Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have recently become the predominant tools for studying graph data. Despite state-of-the-art performance on graph classification tasks, GNNs are overwhelmingly trained in a single domain under supervision, thus necessitating a prohibitively high demand for labels and resulting in poorly transferable representations.

arxiv-2511-08970.title: JW-Flare: Accurate Solar Flare Forecasting Method Based on Multimodal Large Language Models
arxiv-2511-08970.creator: Mingfu Shao, Hui Wang, Yuyang Li, Jiaben Lin, Jifeng Liu, Baolin Tan, Juan Guo, Yin Zhang, Jing Huang, Jiangtao Su, Yingzi Sun, Haiqing Xu, Jie Chen, Suo Liu, Yuanyong Deng, Liyue Tong, Yang Bai, Cunshi Wang, Kaifan Ji, Yuqing Zhou
arxiv-2511-08970.description: Abstract Solar flares, the most powerful explosive phenomena in the solar system, may pose significant hazards to spaceborne satellites and ground-based infrastructure. Despite decades of intensive research, reliable flare prediction remains a challenging task. Large Language Models, as a milestone in artificial intelligence, exhibit exceptional general knowledge and next-token prediction capabilities.

arxiv-2512-20452.title: Projection depth for functional data: Theoretical properties Thanks: This work was supported by the Czech Science Foundation (project no. 24-10822S) and the ERC CZ grant LL2407 of the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport of the Czech Republic.
arxiv-2512-20452.creator: Filip Bočinec, Stanislav Nagy, Hyemin Yeon
arxiv-2512-20452.description: Abstract We introduce a novel projection depth for data lying in a general Hilbert space, called the regularized projection depth, with a focus on functional data. By regularizing projection directions, the proposed depth does not suffer from the degeneracy issue that may arise when the classical projection depth is naively defined on an infinite-dimensional space.

pmc-11314037.title: Impact of Physical Activity on Overall Survival and Liver Cirrhosis Incidence in Steatotic Liver Disease: Insights from a Large Cohort Study Using Inverse Probability of Treatment Weighting
pmc-11314037.creator: Keungmo Yang, Beom Sun Chung, Tom Ryu, Motoyuki Iemitsu
pmc-11314037.description: Physical activity is a cornerstone of a healthy lifestyle, with benefits in managing chronic diseases. This study investigates the relationship between physical activity and liver-related outcomes with or without steatotic liver diseases, including metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and MASLD and increased alcohol intake (MetALD).

pmc-11431820.title: A Cross-Border Biorisk Toolkit for Healthcare Professionals
pmc-11431820.creator: Pierre Vandenberghe, Jessica S Hayes, Maire A Connolly, Jean-Luc Gala, Paul B Tchounwou, Luenda E Charles
pmc-11431820.description: The COVID-19 pandemic posed significant challenges to public health, exposing first responders to high biosafety risks during medical assistance and containment efforts. The PANDEM-2 study aimed to address these critical biosafety issues by emphasising the importance of frequently updated, harmonised guidelines.

pmc-11523169.title: Psychometric properties analysis of Indonesian IKDC scale for managing patients with ACL injury
pmc-11523169.creator: R Deviandri, HC van der Veen, AMT Lubis, MJ Postma, I van den Akker-Scheek
pmc-11523169.description: Introduction:The most-used questionnaire in clinical research for these patients is the International Knee Documentation Committee (IKDC) Subjective Knee Form, as its psychometric properties are considered excellent.Objectives:To assess the validity, reliability, and responsiveness of the Indonesian version of IKDC for use in the Indonesian-speaking ACL population.Material & Methods:After a forward-and-backward translation procedure and cross-cultural adaptation, validity, reliability, and responsiveness were investigated.

pmc-12547186.title: Comparing the Effectiveness of Antidepressants and Cognitive Behavioural Therapy in Preventing Postnatal Depression: A Systematic Review
pmc-12547186.creator: Nadia Shaik
pmc-12547186.description: Postnatal depression (PND) is a prevalent depressive disorder frequently accompanied by anxiety, with significant implications for maternal health and infant development. This systematic review compared the effectiveness of antidepressant medications and cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) in the treatment of PND.
